Definition: dative case (adverb) of a compound of G3956 and G4128; in full multitude, i.e. concertedly or simultaneously:--all at once.
BiblicalUsage: Pamplēthei means all together, with one voice, in full multitude. At Jesus' trial they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the crowd's one voice is the warning: a multitude can agree and still be wrong, and their shout sent an innocent man to the cross.
